jit.vis.bgsubtract.name: jit.vis.bgsubtract
jit.vis.bgsubtract.description: Person segmentation. Produces a grayscale alpha matte that isolates people in the input image from the background, suitable for compositing, masking, or keying.

jit.vis.body.name: jit.vis.body
jit.vis.body.digest: Track body pose (19 joints per person)
jit.vis.body.description: Detects people in the input image and outputs 19 body-joint positions for each, up to 6 people. Joints are the COCO 17 keypoints at rows 0-16, in COCO's own order, plus an additional neck at 17 and root at 18. Coordinates are available as a matrix out the left outlet, as an optional dictionary out the middle outlet, and as an optional drawn overlay.

jit.vis.body.parts.name: jit.vis.body.parts
jit.vis.body.parts.digest: Split a jit.vis.body matrix into its named parts
jit.vis.body.parts.description: Splits the jit.vis.body pose matrix into one float32 matrix per named part (head, torso, left_arm, right_arm, left_leg, right_leg), for every tracked instance, with a dump outlet on the right. Defined by the Vision package as `max define jit.vis.body.parts v8 jit.vis.parts.js body;`. @planecount 4 keeps the confidence plane; @detected 1 drops what the tracker did not find.

jit.vis.debugdraw.name: jit.vis.debugdraw
jit.vis.debugdraw.digest: Draw a jit.vis pose matrix as joints and bones in an OpenGL context
jit.vis.debugdraw.description: Standalone v8 debug drawer for the jit.vis pose trackers: feed it the pose matrix from jit.vis.hands / body / face / facemesh and it draws joints and bones into its drawto context. Defined by the Vision package as `max define jit.vis.debugdraw v8 jit.vis.draw.js;`. Its single outlet is the unused v8 default outlet.

jit.vis.depth.name: jit.vis.depth
jit.vis.depth.description: Monocular depth estimation. Runs a depth model on the input image and outputs a per-pixel depth map as a 1-plane float32 matrix.

jit.vis.face.name: jit.vis.face
jit.vis.face.digest: Track face landmarks (12 regions per face)
jit.vis.face.description: Detects faces in the input image and outputs 12 landmark-region positions for each face (up to 4 faces): eyes, pupils, eyebrows, nose, lips, face contour, and median line. Coordinates are available as a matrix out the left outlet, as an optional dictionary out the middle outlet, and as an optional drawn overlay.

jit.vis.face.parts.name: jit.vis.face.parts
jit.vis.face.parts.digest: Split a jit.vis.face matrix into its named parts
jit.vis.face.parts.description: Splits the jit.vis.face pose matrix into one float32 matrix per named part (left_eye, right_eye, nose, lips, contour), for every tracked instance, with a dump outlet on the right. Defined by the Vision package as `max define jit.vis.face.parts v8 jit.vis.parts.js face;`. @planecount 4 keeps the confidence plane; @detected 1 drops what the tracker did not find.

jit.vis.facemesh.name: jit.vis.facemesh
jit.vis.facemesh.digest: Track the dense face mesh (478 landmarks per face)
jit.vis.facemesh.description: Detects faces in the input image and outputs the full MediaPipe face mesh, 478 landmarks per face, up to 4 faces, as a matrix. Additionally a dictionary of that face's expression and head-pose values, 52 named blendshape scores and a 4x4 head transform, is output. Web engine only.

jit.vis.facemesh.parts.name: jit.vis.facemesh.parts
jit.vis.facemesh.parts.digest: Split a jit.vis.facemesh matrix into its named parts
jit.vis.facemesh.parts.description: Splits the jit.vis.facemesh pose matrix into one float32 matrix per named part (lips, left_eye, left_eyebrow, right_eye, right_eyebrow, face_oval, left_iris, right_iris), for every tracked instance, with a dump outlet on the right. Defined by the Vision package as `max define jit.vis.facemesh.parts v8 jit.vis.parts.js facemesh;`. @planecount 4 keeps the confidence plane; @detected 1 drops what the tracker did not find.

jit.vis.gesture.name: jit.vis.gesture
jit.vis.gesture.digest: Recognize static hand gestures from hand-pose landmarks
jit.vis.gesture.description: Reads the hand-pose matrix produced by jit.vis.hands and turns each hand into a vector of continuous hand-shape features — finger curl, finger spread, pinch distances, palm position and normal — plus a discrete gesture label such as fist, point or peace. Connect the matrix outlet of jit.vis.hands to the input.

jit.vis.grab.name: jit.vis.grab
jit.vis.grab.digest: Camera input UI for the Vision trackers (jit.grab bpatcher)
jit.vis.grab.description: Bpatcher camera source used throughout the Vision help: an On toggle, a Mirror toggle, device and format menus around jit.grab @unique 1 @automatic 0. 0/1 toggles capture, other messages pass to jit.grab. Defined by the Vision package as `max define jit.vis.grab bpatcher @name jit-vis-grab-ui.maxpat;`.

jit.vis.hands.name: jit.vis.hands
jit.vis.hands.digest: Track hand pose (21 landmarks per hand)
jit.vis.hands.description: Detects hands in the input image and outputs 21 landmark positions for each hand (up to 2 hands). Landmark coordinates are available as a matrix out the left outlet, as an optional dictionary out the middle outlet, and as an optional drawn overlay.

jit.vis.hands.parts.name: jit.vis.hands.parts
jit.vis.hands.parts.digest: Split a jit.vis.hands matrix into its named parts
jit.vis.hands.parts.description: Splits the jit.vis.hands pose matrix into one float32 matrix per named part (wrist, thumb, index, middle, ring, little), for every tracked instance, with a dump outlet on the right. Defined by the Vision package as `max define jit.vis.hands.parts v8 jit.vis.parts.js hands;`. @planecount 4 keeps the confidence plane; @detected 1 drops what the tracker did not find.

jit.vis.hands.parts.left.name: jit.vis.hands.parts.left
jit.vis.hands.parts.left.digest: Split a jit.vis.hands matrix into its named parts
jit.vis.hands.parts.left.description: Splits the jit.vis.hands pose matrix into one float32 matrix per named part (wrist, thumb, index, middle, ring, little), for the first tracked hand only (row 0), with a dump outlet on the right. Defined by the Vision package as `max define jit.vis.hands.parts.left v8 jit.vis.parts.js hands @row 0;`. @planecount 4 keeps the confidence plane; @detected 1 drops what the tracker did not find.

jit.vis.hands.parts.right.name: jit.vis.hands.parts.right
jit.vis.hands.parts.right.digest: Split a jit.vis.hands matrix into its named parts
jit.vis.hands.parts.right.description: Splits the jit.vis.hands pose matrix into one float32 matrix per named part (wrist, thumb, index, middle, ring, little), for the second tracked hand only (row 1), with a dump outlet on the right. Defined by the Vision package as `max define jit.vis.hands.parts.right v8 jit.vis.parts.js hands @row 1;`. @planecount 4 keeps the confidence plane; @detected 1 drops what the tracker did not find.

jit.vis.holistic.name: jit.vis.holistic
jit.vis.holistic.digest: Track body, face and both hands in one pass (73 joints)
jit.vis.holistic.description: Detects one person in the input image and outputs the body skeleton, the face landmark regions and both hands together, as a single 73-joint matrix and a dictionary of named joints. The groups are the same joints, in the same order, that jit.vis.body, jit.vis.face and jit.vis.hands report on their own. Web engine only.

jit.vis.holistic.parts.name: jit.vis.holistic.parts
jit.vis.holistic.parts.digest: Split a jit.vis.holistic matrix into its named parts
jit.vis.holistic.parts.description: Splits the jit.vis.holistic pose matrix into one float32 matrix per named part (body, face, left_hand, right_hand), for every tracked instance, with a dump outlet on the right. Defined by the Vision package as `max define jit.vis.holistic.parts v8 jit.vis.parts.js holistic;`. @planecount 4 keeps the confidence plane; @detected 1 drops what the tracker did not find.

jit.vis.objectdetect.name: jit.vis.objectdetect
jit.vis.objectdetect.description: Detects objects in the input image, outputting a normalized bounding box and confidence per object (up to 64) as a matrix, and the class labels as a dictionary.

jit.vis.posemap.name: jit.vis.posemap
jit.vis.posemap.digest: Drive a rigged model from a tracked pose
jit.vis.posemap.description: Takes one row of a pose matrix and turns it into an orientation for every bone of a rigged humanoid model. Connect a jit.vis.body or jit.vis.holistic pose matrix to the input, and the object's left outlet to a jit.gl.model.

jit.vis.segment.name: jit.vis.segment
jit.vis.segment.description: Multi-class image segmentation. Assigns every pixel a category index (such as background, hair, skin, clothing) using a segmentation model chosen with model, and outputs either a label map or a colorized image.

jit.vis.text.name: jit.vis.text
jit.vis.text.description: Detects and reads text in the input image, outputting a normalized bounding box and confidence per text region (up to 64) as a matrix, and the recognized strings as a dictionary.

jit.vis.tondc.name: jit.vis.tondc
jit.vis.tondc.digest: Convert a Vision tracker matrix to normalized device coordinates
jit.vis.tondc.description: Abstraction (patchers/jit.vis.tondc.maxpat) that converts a vision tracker's normalized screen-coordinate matrix to 3-plane normalized device coordinates: X and Y expanded to -1..1, Y flipped, Z zeroed (jit.unpack -> jit.gen codebox -> jit.pack), passing the confidence plane through untouched. Draw the result with jit.gl objects at transform_reset 2 to align with the input image.
